idea: Colors & shapes – colors #2 (LITTLE STARS NURSERY, Jimmy in HOME onesie at the small round nursery table): hook 'Wow! A big blue crayon!' – Jimmy gasps at a big chunky sparkling BLUE crayon held up right beside his face; say-it-with-me 'Blue, blue, blue! Say it with me!'; ORANGE: 'Orange, orange! Orange like an orange!' (blue crayon now lies on the table); PURPLE: 'Purple, purple! Purple like grapes!'; copy-me chorus 'Colors, colors! Clap with me! Blue and orange and purple, see!' with the three crayons standing in a neat row; question to the viewer 'Which one is purple? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'This one! Purple! Yay!' as he taps the purple crayon; lesson 'I know my colors!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now all three crayons standing in a row, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Name three colors: blue, orange and purple – and find the purple one.
calendar: Tuesday 24 Nov 2026, New York 04:41 = slot 1 = Colors & shapes. Series: colors #1 (10 Nov, supermarket) taught red, yellow, green; shapes done 3 Nov + 13 Nov long. Next colors: blue, orange, purple.
place: LITTLE STARS NURSERY (reference nursery.jpg) – first use on the channel; alphabet poster, pencil cups and toy shelves kept out of frame
characters: BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue short-sleeve onesie with a small yellow star, barefoot.
supporting_objects: Big chunky toy crayons, one pure solid color each (wrapper the same color, no writing): BLUE (royal blue), ORANGE, PURPLE.

learning.goal: Name three colors – blue, orange, purple – and find the purple one.
learning.shown_how: One big chunky crayon of one pure color beside Jimmy's face per item (blue, then orange, then purple), then all three standing in a clear row; he taps the purple one.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:18-0:20 'Which one is purple? Hmm?' + 0:20-0:22 humming/daf pause (question boing) -> 0:22 'This one! Purple! Yay!' + cheer + confetti
learning.copy_me: 'Clap with me!' (0:12) and 'Say it with me!' (0:03)
learning.fact_check: Exactly one crayon of each color, pure solid colors; counts per frame checked (f1 1, f2 2, f3 3, f4 3, f5 3); purple is the right one in the row and is the one he taps; grapes can be purple, an orange is orange.
learning.modeling: Positive: Jimmy names colors and answers; nothing wrong to correct.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, big face, calm bright nursery, nothing scary.
